content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Jamia Hamdard Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Jamia Hamdard Guest/Visiting Faculty in Applied Psychology Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Guest/Visiting Faculty in Applied Psychology: A Master's degree in Psychology with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) from a recognized University. The candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET/GPAT/GATE in the concerned subject. OR Ph.D. Degree in Psychology or other relevant discipline. Desirable: 1. Research Publications in reputed national or international referred journals. 2. Relevant work experience in a reputed Industry/Teaching Institution/Research Institution etc.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Jamia Hamdard Guest/Visiting Faculty in Applied Psychology Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Jamia Hamdard is conducting this recruitment drive for the post of Guest/Visiting Faculty in Applied Psychology under advertisement number FR- 12/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Jamia Hamdard Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Guest/Visiting Faculty position in Applied Psychology through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Jamia Hamdard Guest/Visiting Faculty position is scheduled to be held on 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology with 55% marks along with NET/SLET/SET/GPAT/GATE or a Ph.D. Degree in Psychology or other relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Eligible candidates directly need to attend the interview at the designated venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Jamia Hamdard Guest/Visiting Faculty?
faq.answer: The salary and remuneration for the selected candidates will be provided as per the norms established by Jamia Hamdard.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview or applying for these positions.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry a detailed CV, original educational and experience certificates, testimonials, and one set of self-attested photocopies for verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a temporary job opportunity offered by Jamia Hamdard for academic session requirements in the Department of Applied Psychology.
